As Enlink Midstream Partners LP (ENLK) Share Price Declined, Shareholder Salient Capital Advisors Increased Position; Twin Capital Management Position in Wells Fargo & Co New (WFC) Has Cut by $3.52 Million 
April 18, 2018 - By Ellis Scott 
David Simon decreased its stake in Wells Fargo & Co New (WFC) by 23.4% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Twin Capital Management Inc sold 58,720 shares as the company’s stock declined 16.98% with the market. The hedge fund run by David Simon held 192,220 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $11.66M, down from 250,940 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Twin Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Wells Fargo & Co New for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $246.47B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.45% or $0.23 during the last trading session, reaching $50.57. About 25.51M shares traded or 8.08% up from the average. Wells Fargo & Company (NYSE:WFC) has declined 7.75% since April 18, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 19.30% the S&P500. 
Salient Capital Advisors Llc increased its stake in Enlink Midstream Partners Lp (ENLK) by 4.57% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Salient Capital Advisors Llc bought 300,971 shares as the company’s stock declined 17.94% with the market. The institutional investor held 6.89M shares of the public utilities company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $105.90M, up from 6.59M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Salient Capital Advisors Llc who had been investing in Enlink Midstream Partners Lp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $5.14B market cap company. The stock increased 0.69% or $0.1 during the last trading session, reaching $14.61. About 1.58M shares traded or 89.08% up from the average. EnLink Midstream Partners, LP (NYSE:ENLK) has declined 24.93% since April 18, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 36.48% the S&P500. 
Among 21 analysts covering Enlink Midstream Partners ( NYSE:ENLK ), 11 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 10 Hold. Therefore 52% are positive. Enlink Midstream Partners had 63 analyst reports since August 6, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The rating was maintained by Citigroup with “Buy” on Thursday, November 2. As per Thursday, November 2, the company rating was maintained by RBC Capital Markets. The rating was maintained by Robert W. Baird on Tuesday, January 23 with “Buy”. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Tuesday, January 16 by RBC Capital Markets. The firm has “Equal-Weight” rating given on Thursday, February 18 by Barclays Capital. FBR Capital initiated the shares of ENLK in report on Friday, September 9 with “Outperform” rating. The stock of EnLink Midstream Partners, LP (NYSE:ENLK) earned “Equal-Weight” rating by Barclays Capital on Monday, May 9. Morgan Stanley maintained it with “Equal-Weight” rating and $19 target in Friday, November 17 report. The rating was upgraded by JP Morgan on Wednesday, April 4 to “Overweight”. Jefferies initiated the shares of ENLK in report on Wednesday, September 23 with “Buy” rating. 
Salient Capital Advisors Llc, which manages about $5.02B and $4.53B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Western Gas Partners Lp (NYSE:WES) by 65,854 shares to 86,776 shares, valued at $4.17 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Golar Lng Partners Lp (NASDAQ:GMLP) by 760,000 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 681,530 shares, and cut its stake in Kinder Morgan Inc Del (NYSE:KMI). 
Twin Capital Management Inc, which manages about $948.03 million and $2.04 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Becton Dickinson & Co Com (NYSE:BDX) by 2,076 shares to 7,506 shares, valued at $1.61M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 6,780 shares in the quarter, for a total of 382,930 shares, and has risen its stake in Alexion Pharmaceuticals Inc Co (NASDAQ:ALXN). 
Since November 17, 2017, it had 0 insider purchases, and 1 sale for $292,234 activity. 
Investors sentiment increased to 0.75 in 2017 Q4. Its up 0.02, from 0.73 in 2017Q3. It improved, as 63 investors sold WFC shares while 746 reduced holdings. 138 funds opened positions while 466 raised stakes. 3.64 billion shares or 0.11% less from 3.65 billion shares in 2017Q3 were reported. Mirae Asset Glob Invests Company Ltd holds 287,346 shares or 0.23% of its portfolio. Signalpoint Asset Management Limited Liability holds 10,304 shares or 0.39% of its portfolio. State Treasurer State Of Michigan invested 2.11% of its portfolio in Wells Fargo & Company (NYSE:WFC). Monarch Management Inc invested in 1.16% or 51,205 shares. State Of New Jersey Common Pension Fund D, New Jersey-based fund reported 5.14 million shares. The Missouri-based Comm Natl Bank has invested 0.98% in Wells Fargo & Company (NYSE:WFC). Waverton Invest Mgmt Limited owns 29,014 shares. The Pennsylvania-based Guyasuta Investment Advisors Inc has invested 1.81% in Wells Fargo & Company (NYSE:WFC). Nj State Employees Deferred Compensation Plan holds 1.05% or 100,000 shares in its portfolio. 248,060 are held by Meag Munich Ergo Kapitalanlagegesellschaft Mbh. Comerica Inc holds 71,533 shares. Amp holds 2.72 million shares. Jrm Inv Counsel Lc owns 54,690 shares for 2.55% of their portfolio. Sawgrass Asset Mgmt Ltd holds 0.15% or 53,659 shares. 60,499 are owned by Roundview Cap Limited Liability Com. 
Analysts await Wells Fargo & Company (NYSE:WFC) to report earnings on July, 13. They expect $1.17 earnings per share, up 9.35% or $0.10 from last year’s $1.07 per share. WFC’s profit will be $5.70 billion for 10.81 P/E if the $1.17 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.12 actual earnings per share reported by Wells Fargo & Company for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 4.46% EPS growth.
